text: Figure 2.1: Placement of an abstract platform An system designer at an early software design stage may not necessarily care about for example what type of concrete component shall implement the function, or, which type of concrete interface provides the required data; rather the designer just wants to model the interaction between the functional software blocks: i.e. the signal name car- rying the data, the directional flow of the data (providers/consumers) and the physical unit of the data on a high level and leave the further refinement of the design or indeed implementation details to a downstream stage, i.e. separation of concerns.
